name: JevBench Decision Model Leaderboard — Benchmark Heaven
description: Static JevBench snapshot for AI decision models

paragraphs: JevBench by Benchmark Heaven is a benchmark for AI decision models, including Jev-compatible systems. It measures typed decision accuracy, probability calibration, latency and cost. Maintained by Benchmark Heaven, independently of TypeSafe AI.
